identified_security_gaps.gap_title: PAN-OS App-ID Deep Inspection Bypass: Rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook'
identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Setting 'applications = ["any"]' in rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook' disables Palo Alto Layer 7 App-ID deep packet classification. Malicious payloads and non-standard protocols (including C2 tunnels) can bypass firewall inspection across zones ['Trust-DMZ'] -> ['Untrust-Internet'].
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: CIS Palo Alto Firewall Benchmark v1.1.0 (Rule 4.1) & NIST CSF 2.0 PR.PT-04
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Explicitly specify required App-IDs (e.g. applications = ["ssl", "web-browsing"]) in rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook' instead of wildcard 'any'.

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook' permits outbound traffic from source zones ['Trust-DMZ'] to Untrusted Internet with unrestricted wildcard destination addresses ['any']. Workloads can communicate with arbitrary external IP addresses, facilitating data exfiltration.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: CIS Palo Alto Firewall Benchmark v1.1.0 (Rule 4.3) & NIST SP 800-171 3.13.6
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Scope destination_addresses in rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook' to verified partner CIDRs, or route egress traffic through an outbound filtering proxy.

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Palo Alto rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook' between ['Trust-DMZ'] and ['Untrust-Internet'] omits or disables security_profile_group ('none'). Traffic flows without deep packet inspection, antivirus, anti-spyware, or WildFire zero-day sandbox analysis.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: CIS Palo Alto Firewall Benchmark v1.1.0 (Rule 4.2) & NIST SP 800-171 3.13.1
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Attach an approved security profile group (e.g. security_profile_group = 'corporate-threat-prevention-standard') to rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook'.

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook' allows unencrypted cleartext application traffic ['any'] with services ['service-https']. Credentials and payload data can be intercepted via network eavesdropping.
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Require encrypted protocols (e.g. applications = ["ssl"]) and replace cleartext services with secure equivalents in rule 'Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook'.

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Attaching broad managed policy 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess' to role 'role-analytics-ingestion-svc' grants unrestricted wildcard read/write/delete actions over AWS resources, including confidential CUI data assets in the enterprise vault.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: NIST SP 800-171 3.1.1 & CIS AWS Benchmark v1.4.0 (Rule 1.16)
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Replace 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess' with a customer-managed, least-privilege policy scoped to exact S3 bucket actions (e.g. s3:PutObject on telemetry staging).
